title: The Father of Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 97a, and in Zevachim 111b, where Rava said: “Now that the father of Shmuel bar Yitzchak has taught…”

In the Jerusalem Talmud, Rosh Hashanah 1:4 and Challah 1:1, the circumstances of his death are related: he fasted for two days as Yom Kippur because of uncertainty about the date; his intestine burst, and he died. Hyman says that the book Vaad Chachamim, 9b, erred in this matter by attributing it to the father of Shmuel.

notes.text: The passage names the father of Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak. “His intestine burst” follows the full Jerusalem Talmud text, not a ruling about which day was Yom Kippur.
